scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});" && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true});" && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
